title: Past Perfect Continuous vs Past Simple

items.prompt: I was tired because I ____ for hours.
items.hint: Duration before a past moment → had been + V-ing.

items.prompt: She ____ her keys and went home.
They were wet because it ____ all day.
items.translation_tr: Bütün gün yağmur yağdığı için ıslaktılar.

items.prompt: He ____ the email and replied immediately.
items.translation_tr: E-postayı okudu ve hemen cevap verdi.

items.prompt: By 6 p.m., I ____ for three hours.
items.translation_tr: Saat 6’ya kadar üç saattir çalışıyor olacaktım.

items.prompt: The match ended at 5. We ____ it.
items.translation_tr: Maç saat 5’te bitti. Biz maçı izledik.

items.prompt: Her eyes were red because she ____.
I ____ the door and saw a surprise.
items.translation_tr: Kapıyı açtım ve bir sürpriz gördüm.

items.prompt: They were angry because we ____ too long.
items.translation_tr: Çok uzun süre beklediğimiz için kızgındılar.

items.prompt: He ____ his homework, then he played games.
I was tired because I had walked for three hours.
items.answer: I was tired because I had been walking for three hours.
items.hint: Use Past Perfect Continuous for duration before a past moment.

items.prompt: She had been finished her work when I called.
items.answer: She had finished her work when I called.
items.hint: Past Perfect uses had + V3 (not been + V3).

items.prompt: They were dirty because they played in the garden for hours.
items.translation_tr: Saatlerce bahçede oynadıkları için üstleri kirliydi.
items.answer: They were dirty because they had been playing in the garden for hours.

items.prompt: He had been wrote emails all morning.
items.answer: He had been writing emails all morning.

items.prompt: I was late because I had been missed the bus.
items.answer: I was late because I had missed the bus.
items.hint: Missed bus = one completed action → Past Perfect (had missed).

items.prompt: She was happy because she had been pass the exam.
items.answer: She was happy because she had passed the exam.
